services.name: Blue Angels Practice and Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: Rates Adults $55.00: Children 5-12: $45.00 Children 4 and under $30.00 About This is a 3 Hour Dolphin Cruise and Blue Angels Practice Tour on Pensacola Bay. Cruise is on our 42' powerboat tritoon passenger vessel, the Jolly Dolphin. We cover a 20 mile round trip, watching for dolphins, and other marine life, while passing by iconic Pensacola Beach landmarks, such as Fort Pickens, the Pensacola Naval Air Station, and the Pensacola Lighthouse. Our cruise stops at Sand Island, a 40 ft sand dune island, where you can view the Blues up close and personal. services.name: 4 Hour Jolly Mon Blue Angels Practice Sail (up to 6 guests)
services.desc: Watch the Blue Angels from the comfort of the S/V Jolly Mon, offering a special perspective of the US Navy's flight demonstration team during their weekly scheduled practices. These cruises are available most Tuesdays and Wednesdays late March through October per the Blues official practice schedule. On this cruise, we sail or motorsail towards the Naval Air Station, the home of the Blue Angels, and their takeoff location for the practices. The Blues are scheduled to practice at 10:30 a.m. Guests will be able to enjoy the practice from the water, up close and personal! The Angels often fly right over the sailboat. services.name: 4 Hour Jolly Mon Sailing Adventure (up to 6 guests)
services.desc: Climb aboard the Jolly Mon, our 27' sailboat, for a 4 hour sailing adventure with optional swim or snorkel stop! This extended sailing excursion allows plenty of time to cover a lot of water, cruising around Pensacola Bay, Santa Rosa Sound, and/or the Pensacola Pass (entrance to the Gulf of Mexico). Route will depend on conditions. During this cruise we will sail along the beautiful landscape of the National Seashore, taking in the sights and sounds of the open water. Sit back and relax, or take the helm to experience the real joy of sailing! Enjoy the wind in your hair while you look out for dolphins, seabirds, stingrays, turtles and other wildlife.
